_how_to_edit: Weekend Picks shown above the list in the 'This weekend' view. Up to 3 show, in this order. Each pick points at an event in events.json by its exact 'link' AND 'date' (copy both from events.json; some venue links are shared by several shows, so the date is required). Title, venue, price and ticket link all come from events.json. 'label' is a short tag; 'goIf' is one sentence and should only use facts the listing actually states. Picks whose date has passed, or that are outside the current weekend, drop out on their own.

picks.label: Free night out
picks.goIf: Go if you want a dubstep night in Tempe that won't cost you a cover — it's listed as free, 21+.

picks.label: Warehouse night
picks.goIf: Go if you want heavy dubstep in a warehouse room in Phoenix — it's listed as free and 18+.

picks.label: Sunday show
picks.goIf: Go if you want to end the weekend with a Sunday-night rock show at Crescent Ballroom, listed for 7:00 PM.
